name: ux-audit-05b-mobile-retry
description: UX audit stage 5 retry: mobile catalog sheet (longer settle) + mobile Scene/mood section (click scene rail icon).

steps.name: dismiss-overlays
steps.eval: try { localStorage.setItem('hdb_onboarded','1') } catch {}; const s = window.__store.getState(); s.endTour?.(); s.setOnboardingOpen?.(false); s.dismissLocationPrompt?.(); s.setManualHour?.(13)

steps.name: click-scene-rail
steps.eval: (() => { const items=[...document.querySelectorAll('button,[role=tab],[role=button]')]; const b=items.find(x=>/scene/i.test(x.getAttribute('aria-label')||'')||/scene/i.test(x.title||'')); if(b){b.click(); return b.getAttribute('aria-label')||b.title} return 'not-found' })()
